authoritative_resolution.rationale_for_empty_fixture_map: This proof stays fully offline: no live GitHub/registry API lookup was performed for any of the 42 real candidate names or their 9 bare canonical_hint strings, per the mission's own offline constraint and 'Do not resolve shortened social URLs by inference' instruction extended to its logical conclusion for unconfirmed bare-domain hints too.
